label: build-engineer-stone-vein
root_cause: R10 refactor split GenerateGame() into partials. SpawnStoneVeins existed in SceneSetup.Game.Entities.cs but was only called from SetupWorldEntities(), which was never called from the refactored GenerateGame(). SpawnTrees/SpawnWildlife/SpawnBerryBushes all got wired; SpawnStoneVeins was missed.

changes.change: Added stone_vein.png to ForceImportAllSprites paths array (sprite race fix, lesson #1). Added SpawnStoneVeins(layout) call after SpawnTrees in GenerateGame().

Added SpawnStoneVeins(TerrainLayout layout) overload (no tree list required) that delegates to existing SpawnStoneVeins(layout, treePositions) with an empty list. Existing logic unchanged: 12 veins, seed=31415, lake+pawn-spawn avoidance, 4 StoneType weighted distribution.
